questions.prompt: A plugin that registered count_lines stops. What does the next step's request contain?
options: The count_lines schema, because the registry keeps every tool it ever saw
No count_lines schema, because the plugin's disposer removed it from the registry
The count_lines schema marked as disabled
An error, because a step cannot run with fewer tools
questions.explanation: The registration returned a disposer, and the plugin system runs it when the plugin stops. The next step reads the registry as it is now, which no longer has count_lines.

questions.prompt: Why does schemas() copy only the name, description and parameters of each tool?
options: Because the model only needs to know what a tool takes, and the body and callbacks must stay in the harness
Because JSON cannot hold more than three fields
To make the request smaller than the step limit
Because the parameters already contain the body
questions.explanation: The model sees what a tool accepts, never how it runs. Execution and rendering code stay inside the harness.

questions.prompt: Two plugins both try to register a tool named read. What should happen?
options: The second one silently replaces the first
Both stay, and the model picks one
The second registration fails at once
The first one is renamed read_1
questions.explanation: A duplicate name throws when the second plugin registers it, so one tool cannot hide another by accident. dsh refuses duplicates within one layer the same way.
